LanguageData.RPD_Setting_DebugLogDesc: Print full data sent to AI in the developer console.
LanguageData.RPD_Settings_ShowMainButton: Displays icons at the bottom of the interface for quick access to notes and settings.
LanguageData.RPD_Settings_ShowMainButtonTip: Left-click: Open notes;\nRight-click: Open List;\nShift + Left-click: Open Mod settings
LanguageData.RPD_Setting_FilterLabel: Select Data sent to AI (Left: Name, Right: Description):
LanguageData.RPD_Settings_EnableEvolveTip: Shows Evolve and Set Time buttons in the persona editor, allowing for character development over time based on memories. Please be sure to refer to the usage instructions provided on the Workshop page.
LanguageData.RPD_Setting_RimTalkIntegrationDesc: If a preset is selected below, it overrides the internal prompts.
LanguageData.RPD_Tip_GenesDesc: Warning: Descriptions can be very long!
LanguageData.RPD_Tip_NotesDesc: Click 'Edit Notes' button in RimTalk persona editor to modify.
LanguageData.RPD_Tip_RimPsyche: Active only with RimPsyche. Left: only extreme values; Right: all data.
LanguageData.RPD_Notes_Description: Add custom backstory or events here. Global setting: Persists across characters. Update manually.
LanguageData.RPD_Tip_Evolve: Update the persona from memories and elapsed time using the Append or Overwrite mode set on the Auto-Evolve page.
LanguageData.RPD_Tip_SetTime_Empty: Click to record current time/age as baseline for future evolution.
LanguageData.RPD_Tip_SetTime_Info: Last recorded: {0} days ago.\nBiological Age at record: {1}y.\nClick to RESET timer to NOW.
LanguageData.RPD_Batch_SearchTip: Search the currently visible pawn list by name.
LanguageData.RPD_Batch_Button_ModeTooltip: Single Send: Requests AI individually for each pawn. \nBatch Send (Experimental): Sends all data in one request. Tries to create interconnected stories.
LanguageData.RPD_Tip_PromptSwitch: Click to switch the Prompt Preset used for generation
LanguageData.RPD_Message_BatchGeneratedFail: Batch generation failed. AI returned empty result or format error.
LanguageData.RPD_Message_GeneratedFail: Failed to generate for {0}: AI returned empty result.
LanguageData.RPD_Msg_UpdateFailed: Update failed or no changes detected.
LanguageData.RPD_History_RestoreBeforeConfirm: Overwrite the current persona with the version from before this update?
LanguageData.RPD_History_RestoreAfterConfirm: Overwrite the current persona with the version from after this update?
LanguageData.RPD_History_RestoreSuccess: Restored {0}'s persona to an older version.
LanguageData.RPD_AutoEvolve_EnableTooltip: Auto-Evolve master switch. Also enable "Enable Optional Features" in the main mod settings; Auto-Evolve does not run if either switch is off.
LanguageData.RPD_AutoEvolve_DefaultEnabled: Enable for New Pawns by Default
LanguageData.RPD_AutoEvolve_DefaultEnabledTip: Sets the initial Auto-Evolve state for newly generated pawns. Existing pawn settings are not changed.
LanguageData.RPD_AutoEvolve_TriggersTip: Identity category checkboxes control role changes. Optional events are merged per pawn before an Auto-Evolve request.
LanguageData.RPD_AutoEvolve_RoleChangeTip: When a map pawn enters this role, prefer Auto-Gen if it still has its initial persona and both the Auto-Gen master and category switches are on. Otherwise, attempt Auto-Evolve if its master and pawn switches allow it. Auto-Evolve does not depend on the Auto-Gen category switch.
LanguageData.RPD_AutoEvolve_EventMarriageTip: Run Auto-Evolve for both eligible partners after a marriage.
LanguageData.RPD_AutoEvolve_EventBreakupTip: Run Auto-Evolve for both eligible partners after a divorce or breakup.
LanguageData.RPD_AutoEvolve_EventBirthTip: Run Auto-Evolve once per birth batch for eligible parents. Fathers are included only when the parents are lovers, fiancés, or spouses. World pawns are ignored.
LanguageData.RPD_AutoEvolve_EventDirectFamilyDeathTip: Run Auto-Evolve for eligible surviving spouses, parents, and children after a direct family member dies.
LanguageData.RPD_AutoEvolve_EventTraitAddedTip: Run Auto-Evolve when a pawn gains a new active trait after generation.
LanguageData.RPD_AutoEvolve_ModeTooltip: Manual and Auto-Evolve share this mode.\nAppend: Adds new events to the end.\nOverwrite: Rewrites the entire persona.
LanguageData.RPD_AutoEvolve_SpeedProtectTooltip: Prevents API spam when you are fast-forwarding the game.
LanguageData.RPD_AutoEvolve_AdvancedPresetTooltip: Advanced presets receive no automatic update data, event, or JSON instruction; reference variables and request persona JSON yourself. "None" uses the built-in prompt for each mode.
LanguageData.RPD_AutoEvolve_BatchIntervalTip: Apply the cycle to selected pawns. Zero or a negative value disables scheduled Auto-Evolve while keeping role and event triggers available.
